question: Na ukazovateli paliva v aute je vedľa ikonky benzínovej pumpy malá šípka alebo trojuholníček. Čo vodičovi prezrádza?
source_excerpt: an arrow next to the fuel pump symbol in the instrument panel indicates the side of the vehicle on which the fuel filler door is located

extra.why_interesting: Nearly every Slovak driver has pulled up to a pump on the wrong side, especially in a borrowed or rented car. The hint was always on the dashboard, and the player can work it out by thinking about what a driver at a petrol station needs to know.
extra.verification_notes: The arrow beside the fuel pump icon shows which side the fuel filler door is on, per Volvo's support documentation (https://www.volvocars.com/us/support/car/v90/article/588830d089221b31c0a8015166485c00).

explanation: Šípka ukazuje, na ktorej strane auta je uzáver nádrže, takže aj v požičanom aute zastavíte k stojanu správne.
